mechanism: Both drugs inhibit norepinephrine reuptake and duloxetine also inhibits serotonin reuptake, creating potential for serotonin syndrome and increased noradrenergic effects; atomoxetine is metabolized by CYP2D6 which duloxetine inhibits, increasing atomoxetine levels.
action: Monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms, hypertension, and atomoxetine toxicity; consider dose reduction of atomoxetine or alternative ADHD agent; baseline and periodic blood pressure monitoring recommended.
